'''Underdwellers''' were residents of the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant underworld]]. A lack of exposure to the [[Coruscant Prime/Legends|sun]] left their skin [[Milk/Legends|milky]]-white. [[Rath]] was an underdweller.
